line: One river bend, four seasons, one take; each turns when the big tree squats and springs back.
line_cn: 一个河湾一镜过完四季，大树一蹲一弹，就换一季。

camera.serves: time passing; day and night; seasons; a loop
road networks; fields; coverage; data on a grid
before and after; data; several places side by side
how a thing works; underground; under water; inside a building
a lit window; a stall; a bird on a roof
a delivery; a commute; one line joining places

transitions: Transitions: only three — the frame draws in and grows out again;
the ground is cut open (the Cutaway of §8: the same move, whether the cut goes into the ground, a building or water).
No white flash, spin or fast hard cut.
labels: Three centred lines under the frame: line 1, the title, Chinese and English, weight 600, about 25 px, dark; line 2, one sentence, weight 400, about 18 px, grey; line 3, small data (time, solar term, place, coordinates) in a monospace, about 15 px, light grey. Line 3 may change with the picture.

Line 3 is optional, and so is line 2. An empty line leaves its place empty; the others never move up to fill it. With a voice, or when the film's words are bilingual, the type is one Chinese line and one English line: line 1 in Chinese (weight 600, about 25 px, dark) and line 2 in English (weight 400, about 18 px, grey), each on one line, never wrapped; line 3 stays empty unless there is small data to show. In this layout both lines change together, as one pair.

The lines fade in and out with the frame and never move. When a line changes, the old one fades away and the new one fades in; line 1 stays (in the bilingual layout, both lines cross-fade, about 0.4 s out and 0.4 s in). The three marks stay at full strength through every change: only the words fade.
Typefaces: Inter Tight for Latin, Noto Sans SC for Chinese, IBM Plex Mono for data (all OFL).
motion: 60 fps, every frame moves; no stepping, no jitter. The frame's grain boils at 12 fps, which is the only thing on twos.
Shapes may be simple; motion may not. Everything eases. Vehicles accelerate, brake and nod; turns follow smooth curves, never polylines.
All natural motion is procedural and looping: water, trees, cloud shadows, leaves, snow, smoke, flocks. Every object has its own phase; nothing marches in step.
People are distant decoration: small, walking a cycle, flying a kite, rowing. No close-ups, no acting, no hand business.

native_moves.name: Wave
native_moves.does: A ring spreads from one point; everything it passes takes its next state (colours swap per pixel inside the radius; objects grow, open, fall or light up as the ring reaches them).
native_moves.fits: night falling street by street; a change of season; a delivery or signal coverage map; power coming back after an outage. Night falling or day breaking by area follows §3 (night and day as two states); how to build it is in §10.

native_moves.name: Squash and spring
native_moves.does: One landmark squats, springs back, and the change starts from it. Use it to say "this causes that" without a person.
native_moves.fits: a fountain that starts the morning; a factory chimney that starts a shift; a station clock that starts the rush hour.

native_moves.name: Cutaway
native_moves.does: Cut along a line; the near part sinks and slides away to show the section underground, inside a wall or under water.
native_moves.fits: how a metro and its pipes work; a tree's roots; what each floor of a building is doing; fish under a pond. What is revealed is built, not implied: floors with their rooms and furniture, soil in layers, pipes and tunnels, water with what lives in it; every cut face is drawn as a section (flat colour with section hatching), never left hollow. The near part leaves in two steps (a lid rises, then slides back; a wall or a slab of ground sinks straight down), so nothing passes through anything, and it comes back the same way in reverse. The engine has no cutaway built in: §10 says how to make one.

native_moves.name: Grow the frame
native_moves.does: The organic frame grows from the centre to open, draws back in to close, and can close and reopen as a chapter break.
native_moves.fits: an opening; a change of chapter; an ending.

native_moves.name: Living loop
native_moves.does: Every small motion is periodic, so a passage loops seamlessly.
native_moves.fits: a website hero; a screensaver; a livestream background; a live wallpaper.

native_moves.name: Callout
native_moves.does: A pill label with a leader line pops out of the model.
native_moves.fits: explaining a mechanism; labelling data; naming places.

score.note: warm, gentle, continuous: piano, Rhodes, marimba, music box, brushes
